config.title: V380 Pro
config.description: Bridge a V380 camera via its decoder proxy (RTSP, snapshot, PTZ, floodlight).

user.title: Connect V380 decoder proxy
user.description: Point this at a running camera-v380decoder instance (HTTP API port, default 8080). The camera stream, snapshots, PTZ and floodlight are all served from there.

data.name: Device name
data.api_token: Proxy API token (leave empty unless the decoder was started with --api-token)

abort.already_configured: This V380 proxy is already configured.
